objective: Repair the existing touchless camera zoom on web and React Native without modifying original or protected business logic

decision.action: Run the existing hand tracker in an isolated browser camera surface and bridge validated zoom events to the existing map
evidence: AppContext instantiates getUserMedia controller directly in Hermes
Leaflet default zoomSnap rounds away sub-half-step gesture deltas
stop during camera permission does not invalidate pending start
decision.risk: Camera permission and platform WebView compatibility

acceptance_criteria: Native bundle contains no MediaPipe browser runtime
Camera lifecycle cancels stale permission/model work and releases tracks
Real detection assets resolve and GPU failure has CPU fallback
Pinch/spread events change map zoom without modifying route logic
Status, retry and stop controls work without per-frame app renders
Typecheck, gesture regression tests and platform exports pass
limitations: Physical hand recognition and iPhone permissions require hardware; report separately from simulated tests
Do not revert concurrent Expo 58 upgrade or other user changes
